text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, it's so soggy and mushy~
How do I make it taste good?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, Mayano-san.
Were you cooking something?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup! If I wanna become a mature woman,
I gotta know how to cook!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...But I still don't really get it.
My fried rice turned into a total disaster.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see. However, there is no need to lose heart.
One can always learn from one's failures.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Allowing varied experiences to foster your personal growth—
is that not precisely what it means to become an adult?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see... Ah, then what about you, King-chan?!
Can you cook like a real mature woman?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Er... well, naturally! As if there is anything
that the first-class King cannot accomplish!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, amazing!
Then teach Maya how to cook, pleaseee!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...V-Very well, I don't mind! I shall grant you
the privilege of learning the culinary arts from King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
First, we must cook the rice... Wait, rinse-free rice?
Does that mean it hasn't been washed yet? Wash it
before King has to wash it herself...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Next is chopping the green onions...
Carefully... carefully...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, add the eggs into the frying pan...
Phew, that went splendidly!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And next—add the rice immediately, you say?!
Wait, say so sooner!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's kinda... pitch black~~~?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kuh... Yes, indeed! It is pitch black!
However, we have learned a valuable lesson from this!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! Next time, I shall display
the first-class cooking of the first-class King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No good, it has turned soggy again...
At this rate, we must relearn from the fundamentals.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, first fry the beaten eggs.
Using cold leftover rice makes it flakier—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, King-chan. It looks super tough, so
you don't have to push yourself this hard for Maya's sake...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Mayano-san.
You are mistaken about one thing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-class lady cannot simply back down just because she cannot do something.
—Otherwise, I cannot take pride in myself.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize for dragging you along with me.
However, I will certainly fulfill my promise—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I came across King Halo
and Mayano Top Gun spending time together.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It was really delicious!
King-chan's fried rice!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! When it comes to this King,
even cooking is a mere walk in the park!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it?
Did it serve as good reference for your cooking?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I'm sowwy!
Maya fell asleep halfway through the cooking yesterday!
So I didn't really get to see it, I guess~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What was that, you say—!?
After all that trial and error, I finally managed to make that one dish, so I cannot simply make it again, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. But you know, King-chan!
Maya couldn't learn the recipe, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I definitely learned what it truly means to be first-class!
